verses.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
lines: A good name is more desirable than great riches,
and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

verses.text: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
lines: The rich and the poor have this in common:
Yahweh is the maker of them all.

verses.text: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
lines: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself;
but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

verses.text: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
lines: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh
is wealth, honor, and life.

verses.text: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.
lines: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked:
whoever guards his soul stays from them.

verses.text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
lines: Train up a child in the way he should go,
and when he is old he will not depart from it.

verses.text: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
lines: The rich rule over the poor.
The borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.text: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
lines: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble,
and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

verses.text: He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
lines: He who has a generous eye will be blessed;
for he shares his food with the poor.

verses.text: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
lines: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out;
yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

verses.text: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
lines: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully
is the king’s friend.

verses.text: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
lines: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge;
but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

verses.text: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
lines: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside!
I will be killed in the streets!”

verses.text: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
lines: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit.
He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.

verses.text: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
lines: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child:
the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

verses.text: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
lines: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich,
both come to poverty.

verses.text: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
lines: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise.
Apply your heart to my teaching.

verses.text: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
lines: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you,
if all of them are ready on your lips.

verses.text: I teach you today, even you, So that your trust may be in Yahweh.
lines: I teach you today, even you,
So that your trust may be in Yahweh.

verses.text: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
lines: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things
of counsel and knowledge,

verses.text: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
lines: To teach you truth, reliable words,
to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

verses.text: Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
lines: Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor;
and don’t crush the needy in court;

verses.text: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
lines: for Yahweh will plead their case,
and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

verses.text: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
lines: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man,
and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:

verses.text: lest you learn his ways, and ensnare your soul.
lines: lest you learn his ways,
and ensnare your soul.

verses.text: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
lines: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands,
of those who are collateral for debts.

verses.text: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
lines: If you don’t have means to pay,
why should he take away your bed from under you?

verses.text: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
lines: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone
which your fathers have set up.

verses.text: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
lines: Do you see a man skilled in his work?
He will serve kings.
He won’t serve obscure men.
